name: @portiq/cli
description: Portiq CLI — run saved API requests, collections, and flows from the terminal.

scripts.bundle: npm run build && esbuild dist/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --external:better-sqlite3 --outfile=dist/portiq.bundle.cjs && node -e "require('fs').chmodSync('dist/portiq.bundle.cjs', 0o755)"
